reasoning: The 1780 German text 'Geschichte der africanischen Bauherren' by Köppen is a minor Masonic history preserved in the Kloss collection. Exhaustive search of German Masonic bibliographies (Freimaurer-Wiki, Stichtingargus), English Masonic encyclopedias, WorldCat, archive.org, HathiTrust, and general web found no prior English translation. The Crata Repoa (a different Köppen text) has English translations, but this historia has none. Evidence is moderate because WorldCat access was restricted.
